CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red set) and its organization/presentation and a separate origin/status are explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the same content's organization/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (red/blue sets) are listed for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are reported separately from the content identities, distinguishing source/status across contents.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states spatial layout and lists content membership, describing how content is organized/presented for current referents.
